The density array follows a Z-major, Y-major, X-minor contiguous layout [S1, unofficial].

The evidence explicitly provides the core lookup logic: `grid->density[(zi * grid->resolution + yi) * grid->resolution + xi]`. In this formula, `xi` (X) is the least significant index (multiplied by 1), `yi` (Y) is the next significant index (multiplied by resolution), and `zi` (Z) is the most significant index (multiplied by resolution squared). This corresponds to a Z-major, Y-major, X-minor contiguous layout.
